name: BMG Harvest Closure Meta-analysis
aliases: Closure versus non-closure of the intraoral buccal mucosa graft site in urethroplasties
question: Does leaving the buccal mucosa graft harvest site open reduce oral morbidity compared with primary closure in patients having urethroplasty?

design.blinding: Outcome assessment unblinded in all seven pooled trials

arms.label: Nonclosure of the buccal mucosa graft harvest site (healing by secondary intention)
primary closure of the harvest site

design.population: 373 patients over 18 years with urethral stricture and unilateral intraoral graft harvest for urethroplasty, pooled from seven randomized or quasi-randomized trials; women and children were excluded.
design.description: Systematic review and meta-analysis of seven comparative trials
design.locator: PMC9930765 full text, Methods, Results, Table 1

verdictNote: Early pain favored nonclosure; no overall pooled difference for pain, numbness, salivation, diet or mouth opening.
takeaway: Meta-analysis of seven randomized studies (373 patients) of oral-mucosal graft harvest-site nonclosure versus primary closure: nonclosure lowered day 0–1 oral pain; pooled overall pain, numbness, salivation, diet and mouth-opening outcomes showed no statistically significant difference, and the 6-month mouth-opening advantage was driven by one trial.

reports.label: Systematic review and meta-analysis
reports.citation: Güler Y. Comparison of closure versus non-closure of the intraoral buccal mucosa graft site in urethroplasties. A systematic review and meta-analysis. *Arab J Urol.* 2023;21(1):18-30. doi:10.1080/2090598X.2022.2097613
reports.followUp: Pooled trial follow-up of 6 months for most outcomes; numbness to 12 months
reports.followUpLocator: PMC9930765 full text, Methods, Data extraction

results.measure: Pooled pain score across day 0–1, day 3–7 and 1–6 month time points; standardized mean difference, nonclosure minus closure (negative favors nonclosure)
results.note: Seven trials; I² 64%. The report's text gives p=0.30 after sensitivity analysis and, in one passage, p=0.006 with a different interval; the forest plot is used. Pain scales differed between trials.
results.locator: PMC9930765 full text, Figure 5; Results, Pain score

results.measure: Pooled risk across day 1, day 5–7, 1–3 month and 6 month time points; risk ratio, nonclosure versus closure
results.note: Five trials; events are counted at each time point, so a patient can contribute more than once. I² 57%.

results.measure: Pooled risk at day 3–7 and 1–12 months; risk ratio, nonclosure versus closure
results.note: Five trials; I² 0%. The report's text gives RR 0.91 (0.76–1.08), p=0.28; the forest plot is used.

results.measure: Pooled risk of salivation change at day 1, day 5–7, 6 months and unspecified times; risk ratio, nonclosure versus closure
results.note: Four trials; I² 7%. The report's text gives 1.05 (0.61–2.10), p=0.87; the forest plot is used.

results.endpoint: Tolerance of liquid and solid diet
results.measure: Pooled proportion tolerating liquid or solid intake at day 1–7 and 1–6 months; risk ratio, nonclosure versus closure
results.note: Six trials; events are patients tolerating the diet. I² 48%. The report's text gives 0.96 (0.90–1.02), p=0.21; the forest plot is used.

results.measure: Pain score on day 0–1; standardized mean difference, nonclosure minus closure (negative favors nonclosure)
results.note: Seven trials; I² 70%. Time-point subgroup without multiplicity adjustment.

results.measure: Pain score on day 0–1 after removing Muruganandam 2009 and Gulani 2019 for heterogeneity; standardized mean difference, nonclosure minus closure (negative favors nonclosure)
results.note: Five trials; I² 53%. Reported in the text only; the group sizes are not given.
results.locator: PMC9930765 full text, Results, Pain score

results.measure: Pain score on day 3–7; standardized mean difference, nonclosure minus closure (negative favors nonclosure)
Pain score at 1–6 months; standardized mean difference, nonclosure minus closure (negative favors nonclosure)
Risk of difficult mouth opening at 6 months; risk ratio, nonclosure versus closure
results.note: Three trials, one not estimable; I² 0%. Soave 2018 contributed 14/41 versus 24/42; the other two trials had 1/25 versus 2/25 and 0/24 versus 0/26. Time-point subgroup without multiplicity adjustment.

results.measure: Risk of difficult mouth opening at day 5–7; risk ratio, nonclosure versus closure
Risk of difficult mouth opening on day 1; risk ratio, nonclosure versus closure
Risk of difficult mouth opening at 1–3 months; risk ratio, nonclosure versus closure

harms.label: Perioral numbness
harms.note: Events at day 3–7 and 1–12 months combined, so a patient can be counted more than once.

harms.label: Alteration of salivation
harms.note: Events at day 1, day 5–7, 6 months and unspecified times, so a patient can be counted more than once.

delivery.label: Trials and patients included
delivery.note: 1,150 records identified, 670 screened by title and abstract, 29 full texts assessed, 7 included. Soave 2018 contributed 135 patients (72 nonclosure, 63 closure).

delivery.label: Graft site in the included trials
delivery.value: Unilateral cheek in 3 trials; unilateral cheek with bilateral cheek or lower lip for some patients in 2; lingual mucosa in 1; not stated in 1
delivery.note: Graft shape was rectangular in 2 trials, ovoid in 2 and not stated in 3.

delivery.label: Closure technique in the closure arms
delivery.value: Continuous suture in 3 trials per the text (4 trials cited), interrupted suture in 2, not stated in 1
delivery.note: The report's count and its citations for continuous closure disagree.

delivery.label: Pain scales
delivery.value: 5-point scale in 1 trial; 10- or 11-point scales in 3; 2 did not define the scale
delivery.note: Pain scores were pooled as standardized mean differences.
